div.h2: Our story starts in a Colorado nursery.

div.p: Our founder spent years running a local garden center in Kittredge, Colorado, growing everything from houseplants to trees. That experience laid the roots for Ambary Gardens. Today, our team grows hemp in our own Colorado greenhouses, where every plant is tended and harvested by hand.
